capabilities.capability: New ticket status waiting_on_requester with its own transitions

found.quote: A ticket in progress may enter `waiting_on_requester`; it may then resume in progress or resolve.
From waiting_on_requester the agent can return to in_progress when a response arrives, or resolve the ticket.
